hypothesis: W-R32's 8-bit to 1/2/4-bit accuracy drop affects the all-observed as well as marker-aware fixed model. At 4-bit and potentially 2-bit, the weakness may be out-of-distribution feature/weight calibration rather than irreversible lack of temporal information. A newly trained equal-budget 16-weight learner exposed only to quantized DEVELOPMENT data may recover heldout accuracy without hidden labels or extra channels.
freeze: Independent new dev1136..1151 and new heldout1152..1167; quantize high bits 8/4/2/1 using unchanged W-R32 encoder, fixed three generator families, fixed sites and noise offsets, frozen perceptron epochs/learning rate/evaluation thresholds. Every training pair retained, even if quantization causes positive and negative to be observationally identical. No postresult budget or feature tuning.

source_split.previous_w32_heldout: 1080..1095 is historical evidence only, not used for tuning

training: Affine-prior 16 development seeds * 9 entities *3 predefined tail swap sites 2/5/8 * two noise amplitudes 1/2 * balanced original/swapped labels=1728 examples PER precision/arm. Noise offset 17; all quantized candidate states legitimate clean observations. 32 fixed perceptron epochs, LR0.1, 16 weights plus bias. No sample dropping or extra budget. A fixed frozen W-R22 model is a reference-only benchmark (its original training is not rerun on new development).
arms: frozen_maskaware: original W-R22 trained maskaware_augmented 16-weight/bias model
refit_multimarker: equal-budget 16-weight perceptron trained on observed-only W-R25 multi marker feature at each precision
refit_allobserved: equal-budget perceptron trained on W-R19 raw top-two temporal feature at each precision
primary: For all 3 heldout generator families x 2 tail swaps x 4 precisions, report per-seed paired TP/TN/FP/FN, quantization identity collisions, training updates, and heldout accuracy for all arms. RECOVERY iff 4-bit or 2-bit refit accuracy exceeds frozen model by >=0.10 on aggregate matched cells while equal parameters/training examples/epochs; PARTIAL_RECOVERY iff gain >=0.05 but <0.10; NO_RECOVERY otherwise. Keep all harms and negative outcomes.
controls: Never query or fit on heldout seeds1152..1167; fix training data and code before first use
Keep entire positive/negative pair even when quantization makes observation byte-identical; report inseparability explicitly
No label oracle in features, no extra train examples or changing training epochs, split, model width, learning rate, stopping rule or precision mapping
One immutable original first-use artifact, full Go test/build, no retry or accepted-reference mutation
claim_limit: Bounded synthetic quantized temporal prediction and equal-budget retraining, not language understanding or real-world deployment.
